es.subtitulo: El mundo canta si te gusta escuchar

bloques.html:
Señor, ¡qué difícil ha sido!

La compuse hace 6 años, y no me quedo corto si digo que llegar hasta aquí ha sido una odisea. Un viaje de ida a lo intimamente desconocido y vuelta.

Nimbo salió el viernes y, nada más unirme a la meditación con la comunidad, me puse a llorar. Vi como una película de todas las etapas del viaje, los momentos más difíciles, y cómo la luz llegaba invariablemente a quitar mi alma de las manos del miedo. El resto de la media hora fue una meditación sobre cómo la esperanza está totalmente justificada cuando uno va de la mano de Dios. No hay obstáculo que se le resista. Lo que para nosotros es una montaña, para Él no es ni una pluma.

Después, este poema-oración vino para expresar esa odisea (trans)personal que acababa de revisar, inspirado en la oración tradicional judía “Dayenú” ("Nos hubiera bastado"):

Si Dios me hubiera mostrado, a mis 21, que era su hijo amado y que no había nada que perdonar
Me habría bastado

Si me hubiera sacado del camino de ingeniero y llevado a volar al campo abierto
Me habría bastado

Si me hubiera dado una sola canción inspirada
Me habría bastado

Si me hubiera abierto el corazón y sanado las heridas ahí guardadas
Me habría bastado

Si me hubiera enviado a un mendigo con las piernas rotas tumbado en la acera para enseñarme a ver a Cristo en cada hombre
Me habría bastado

Si me hubiera traído un buen maestro que me enseñara que mi verdadera voluntad es conocer a Dios
Me habría bastado

Si me hubiera traído Un Curso de Milagros para enseñarme a perdonar
Me habría bastado

Si hubiera restaurado el amor y la armonía en mi familia
Me habría bastado

Si me hubiera sanado la voz tras cuatro años de faringitis constantes
Me habría bastado

Si me hubiera acompañado por el infierno que fue sanar mi relación con la comida
Me habría bastado

Si, en mi soledad más dolorosa, me hubiera llamado al matrimonio, me hubiese traído a Betül y hubiese cumplido su promesa
Me habría bastado

Si me hubiera puesto en manos de Jesús y enseñado a escuchar su Voz
Me habría bastado

Si me hubiera dado la oportunidad de grabar mis canciones
Me habría bastado

Si hubiera disuelto con amor los miedos que me impedían compartirlas
Me habría bastado

Si después de esto no llegaran más canciones
Me habría bastado

Si no llegara a comprender nada más
Me habría bastado

Si mañana este cuerpo cayese
Me habría bastado

Porque me has dado mucho más de lo que habría sido razonable pedir.

¿Cómo no querer darte de vuelta lo que tengo?

Te doy mi voz
Te doy mi cuerpo
Te doy mi mente
Te doy mi matrimonio
Te doy mi trabajo
Te doy mis días

Para que todo lo que es del Alfa
sea también del Omega

Y si después de todo esto
solo quedase
amar en silencio,
orar,
y laborar,

Me habría bastado

en.subtitulo: The world sings if you like to listen.
en.extracto: Last Friday, Nimbo came out, the first single from my new album, Silent Transmission.

bloques.html: Last Friday, Nimbo came out, the first single from my new album, Silent Transmission.
bloques.plano: Last Friday, Nimbo came out, the first single from my new album, Silent Transmission.

bloques.html:
Lord, how hard it has been!

I composed it six years ago, and I am not exaggerating when I say that getting here has been an odyssey. A journey into the intimately unknown and back.

Nimbo came out on Friday and, the moment I joined the meditation with the community, I began to cry. I saw, like a film, all the stages of the journey, the hardest moments, and how the light would invariably come to take my soul out of the hands of fear. The rest of the half hour was a meditation on how hope is entirely justified when one walks hand in hand with God. There is no obstacle that can resist Him. What for us is a mountain, for Him is not even a feather.

Afterward, this prayer-poem came to express that (trans)personal journey I had just reviewed, inspired by the traditional Jewish prayer "Dayenu" ("It would have been enough"):

If God had shown me, at 21, that I was his beloved son and that there was nothing to forgive
It would have been enough

If he had taken me off the path of engineering and let me fly in the open field
It would have been enough

If he had given me a single inspired song
It would have been enough

If he had opened my heart and healed the wounds kept there
It would have been enough

If he had sent me a beggar with broken legs lying on the pavement to teach me to see Christ in every man
It would have been enough

If he had brought me a good teacher who taught me that my true will is to know God
It would have been enough

If he had brought me A Course in Miracles to teach me to forgive
It would have been enough

If he had restored love and harmony in my family
It would have been enough

If he had healed my voice after four years of constant pharyngitis
It would have been enough

If he had accompanied me through the hell of healing my relationship with food
It would have been enough

If, in my most painful loneliness, he had called me to marriage, brought me Betül, and fulfilled his promise
It would have been enough

If he had placed me in the hands of Jesus and taught me to hear his Voice
It would have been enough

If he had given me the opportunity to record my songs
It would have been enough

If he had dissolved with love the fears that prevented me from sharing them
It would have been enough

If after this no more songs were to come
It would have been enough

If I were to understand nothing more
It would have been enough

If tomorrow this body were to fall
It would have been enough

Because You have given me far more than it would have been reasonable to ask.

How could I not want to give back to You what I have?

I give You my voice
I give You my body
I give You my mind
I give You my marriage
I give You my work
I give You my days

So that all that belongs to the Alpha
may also belong to the Omega

And if after all this
only remained
to love in silence,
to pray,
and to labor,

It would have been enough.
